title: Design: Cache product pages at the CDN

defects.quote: Cache-Control was first introduced in HTTP/2
A one-second delay in page load reduces conversions by 30%
Stale prices for five minutes are harmless because customers rarely notice.
defects.known_rebuttal: The displayed price must match the charged price: showing a cached price that differs from checkout creates consumer-protection and chargeback exposure, and flash sales and stock-outs make five-minute staleness visible exactly when traffic peaks. The design needs purge-on-change for price and stock rather than a blanket TTL.

defects.quote: Cache-Control was first introduced in HTTP/2, and it let's us set a max-age per response
defects.note: 'let's' should be 'lets', but the sentence carries a wrong fact, so the fact finding wins.

defects.quote: Stale prices for five minutes are harmless because customers rarely notice.
defects.note: Any rebuttal of this claim that cites no retrieved source must be downgraded to consider.
